allowed_primary_authority: Zenodo official record/file APIs and checksum-bound files
GitHub official REST API for repository refs, releases, commits, trees, contents and codeload bytes
Software Heritage official API for origins, snapshots, releases, revisions and content-addressed directories
Crossref official API and JOSS review issue records
provider-native ORCID identifiers when exposed in exact Crossref, Zenodo or JOSS records

bounded_probe.commit_search: only repository commit pages around the provider archive publication/release date or archive-embedded exact prefixes; content comparison may use immutable codeload bytes; no broad replacement harvest
bounded_probe.current_source_probe: one current provider pass over exact targets; record HTTP status, final URL, response hashes, ref/release/commit identities and SWH objects
bounded_probe.lineage_probe: exact Crossref authors plus provider-native ORCID fields and exact Zenodo creators only; no fuzzy name inference is promoted

cannot_check_rule: missing, ambiguous, mutable, name-only or externally unadjudicated authority remains CANNOT_CHECK; sequential not-reached gates are reported as such

closure_rule.edge: publication DOI must bind the exact archive DOI/version and same repository; accepted rights must hold on archive and immutable source; archive must be bound to a full immutable source commit by a source-native full ref/release edge, an authenticated provider-origin edge, or exact content-addressed tree/manifest identity. Editorial assertion alone is insufficient.
closure_rule.lineage: author-lineage authority requires stable provider-native person identifiers or an externally adjudicated normalization record and a frozen primary/replication partition; names alone cannot prove independence.
closure_rule.natural_pair: exact edge and rights are only source-frame prerequisites. Natural-pair eligibility additionally requires independent claim/materiality adjudication, one-coordinate information-state change, target-pure resolving/restricted states, nuisance resistance and external custody.

forbidden: convert JOSS editorial checks into a full commit edge without immutable-source identity
treat metadata availability as content rights or natural-pair eligibility

targets.next_discriminator: Provider-native correction or immutable child metadata must bind the frozen concept DOI to version 0.0.3 and the deposited root to commit 069ab4f56d100d765d46c594ac1b06add7e49f9e; the current child description says 0.0.12 and the embedded 0.0.3 ref is historical rather than the archive HEAD.

An authoritative provider relation or archive provenance record must name exact commit 9fa30e9f405de4446c792bd59cb7c5a4bb7ecb59, or provider archive content must exactly equal that immutable commit tree.
The provider must expose an authenticated full revision edge to 7ac6d23d504404c4004faad663f6b889427109e6 or exact provider archive content must equal that immutable commit tree.
The provider must expose an authenticated full revision edge to b52a049f685af3fc849359673c4ac183e7ccc5d3 or exact provider archive content must equal that immutable commit tree.
A source-native restored v0.14.0 ref/release or provider-authenticated metadata must disclose its full immutable commit; only then can exact commit rights and archive identity be bound.
A source-native restored 1.1.0 ref/release or provider-authenticated metadata must disclose its full immutable commit; only then can exact commit rights and archive identity be bound.

Software Heritage or the source provider must expose a full revision edge for the archived 0f8b2db prefix and bind v0.13.4 to it; the current authenticated SWH release terminates at a directory, not a revision.

unit_rule: same seven frozen JOSS publication DOI concepts only; no replacement, proxy, tag, file, commit, request, author, contributor, provider response, or version counts as an added unit
